catalog.name: screenshot_url
catalog.label: Screenshot URL
catalog.description: Screenshot a page. For static HTML/CSS/JS pass the file path (index.html) — the harness opens it directly. For running apps pass http://localhost:…. Returns the image plus console errors and failed requests. fullPage defaults to false.

url.description: Workspace HTML path (index.html) or a live http(s) URL. Static pages: pass the file path — do not start a server. Live apps: http://localhost:5173

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page height. Defaults to false — only the viewport is captured. Set true when you need to see content below the fold. Full-page screenshots are large and consume significant context.

viewport.description: Viewport dimensions. Defaults to 1280x900 (desktop). Use e.g. { width: 390, height: 844 } for mobile.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 900.

timeoutMs.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000. Increase for slow apps.

catalog.promptSnippet: Screenshot a workspace HTML file or a live URL (no server needed for static pages)
promptGuidelines: After creating or modifying frontend code, verify with verify_ui or screenshot_url before claiming done
Static HTML: pass the file path (index.html). Do not start Python, Node, PHP, or any HTTP server just to screenshot
Live apps (Vite/Next/API): pass the http://localhost URL of the already-running app
Default is viewport-only — set fullPage: true only when you need content below the fold
Use viewport option to simulate mobile (e.g. { width: 390, height: 844 })
Check console errors and failed requests in the metadata to diagnose issues
The screenshot is already visible in the transcript. Do not mkdir Snapshots or write the image to disk

catalog.name: interact_then_screenshot
catalog.label: Interact & Screenshot
catalog.description: Perform a sequence of interactions on a page then take a screenshot of the resulting state. Use for login flows, form submissions, navigation to protected routes, or any UI state that requires user actions to reach. Each browser session is isolated — you must perform login and navigation in a single call to reach authenticated state.

url.description: Workspace HTML path or live http(s) URL to open first. Static pages: pass the file. Do not start a server just to screenshot.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to perform before screenshotting. Use this for login flows, form submissions, or any UI state requiring interaction.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element.

value.description: Text to type into the selected element.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page height. Defaults to false. Only set true when you need to see content below the fold.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 900.

timeoutMs.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.

catalog.promptSnippet: Interact with a page (click, fill, navigate) then take a screenshot
promptGuidelines: Use interact_then_screenshot for flows that need clicks/fills — login, forms, modals
Static HTML: pass the file path. Do not start a local server just to screenshot
After creating or modifying frontend flows, verify before claiming done — verify_ui with actions gives a verdict without loading the image into context
Each call starts with a fresh browser session — log in in the same call to reach protected routes
Actions are executed sequentially: fill → click → wait → navigate

catalog.name: verify_ui
catalog.label: Verify UI claim
catalog.description: Verify a concrete claim about a web page by screenshotting it and judging the image against the claim. Returns PASS, FAIL, or UNCLEAR with one line of evidence — the screenshot itself is not returned unless no vision-capable judge is available. Use after building or modifying UI to confirm the result before claiming the work is done. State one specific, visible claim per call.

url.description: Workspace HTML path (index.html) or a live http(s) URL. Static pages: pass the file — do not start a server.

claim.description: Concrete, checkable claim about the page, e.g. "the login button is visible and enabled" or "the snake game canvas renders a grid". One claim per call.

actions.description: Optional interactions (fill/click/wait/navigate) to reach the state under test before judging.

viewport.description: Viewport dimensions. Defaults to 1280x900. Use 390x844 for mobile.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page height. Defaults to false (viewport only).

timeoutMs.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.

catalog.promptSnippet: Verify a concrete UI claim against a real screenshot (LLM judge)
promptGuidelines: After creating or modifying frontend code, verify the result with verify_ui before claiming the task is done
Static HTML: pass the file path (index.html). Do not start a web server just to verify
State one concrete, visible claim per call (e.g. 'the submit button is visible and enabled'), not vague ones like 'the page looks good'
On FAIL: read the evidence, fix the cause, then re-verify — do not retry the same claim unchanged
On UNCLEAR: make the claim more specific or interact first (login, navigate) with the actions option
Use screenshot_url instead when you want to see the image yourself rather than get a verdict
